title: Screaming Chickens
description: This pack makes chickens scream (loudly), like the screaming chicken on a tree meme.
body:
_Fun Fact: This makes chickens sound more like a siren creepypasta than a chicken..._

Basically, a chicken is a pretty complex mob, with normal, baby and picky sounds **seperately**. So I put the normal pitch on normal, baby pitch on baby and a subtle pitch reduction for the picky one.

### Enjoy the screaming madness!
